summary: Default st gh watch to fourteen days, with explicit --until none for indefinite watches.

replay.detail: Stored watch deadlines remain authoritative through reopen and replay.

schema.detail: Uses the existing optional deadline field and watch declarations.

rules.detail: No registry or retention rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Omitting until on the GitHub watch API creates a fourteen-day deadline; none explicitly opts out. Existing indefinite declarations and implicit comment watches retain their existing behavior. Empty explicit deadlines are refused. Running st gh watch again on a thread without --until now replaces an indefinite or earlier deadline with a fresh fourteen days; previously, an omitted deadline meant indefinite. A watch that reaches its deadline ends and its owner is told with a message, so automation that registers once and expects the watch to persist must re-register or pass --until none.

manual.detail: No migration; use --until none when creating an indefinite watch.

recovery.detail: Reopen preserves the exact stored finite or indefinite lifetime.

downtime.detail: No storage migration or added startup work.
